body: _comment: "${1:Generated by DesWatch — fill in your design tokens below}"
${5:Describe the overall design language — brand values, visual principles, and the intended audience for this design system.}
${6:Document the colour palette, including primary, secondary, surface, and semantic colours (error, warning, success). Include usage guidelines for each.}
${7:Document the type scale: font families, sizes, weights, and line heights for each named text style. Explain when to use each style.}
Document the grid system, column counts, gutters, margins, and the spacing scale derived from the base unit.
Document the shadow and layering system. List each elevation level, its intended use (cards, dialogs, navigation), and its box-shadow value.
Document the border-radius scale and the shape language it conveys.
Document component-level token overrides. For each component, list the tokens it consumes and any composition rules.
${8:List the most important usage rules as bullet pairs. Each pair should have one positive example (Do) and one anti-pattern (Don't).}
